# Counter-stimulus fixture for _ctl/tests/download-coverage.test.sh.
#
# The shape of _build/download-exemptions.txt: 1 row per download that takes a
# STATED CLASS instead of a digest.
#
#   <governed file>|<url exactly as the file writes it>|<class>|<reason>
#
# A comment row and a blank row are not rows. Both appear here, because a
# reader that counts them reports defects that are not there.

# A real site of Dockerfile, answered correctly. The detectors must be quiet
# about it in both directions.
download-coverage/Dockerfile|https://example.invalid/exempt-installer.sh|unversioned-url|the installer tracks master, so there is no version to pin

# A real site that ALSO passes a digest to the helper. Two answers, so the
# double-classification detector must report it.
download-coverage/Dockerfile|https://example.invalid/double-classified.tar.gz|not-installed-today|a second answer for a download that already carries a digest

# GHOST ON PURPOSE. No file holds this URL. It is the #107 shape: the rule reads
# a listing instead of reading what the file CONSUMES, so the row goes on
# describing a download that was deleted or rewritten, and the coverage it
# reports is coverage of nothing.
download-coverage/Dockerfile|https://example.invalid/removed-tool.tar.gz|unversioned-url|the URL this row names is fetched by no governed file

# A class outside the taxonomy. A typo answers a download into nothing while it
# looks like an answer.
download-coverage/Dockerfile|https://example.invalid/bad-class.tar.gz|probably-fine|the class name is not one of the 2 the taxonomy allows

# 3 fields, not 4. The reason is what a human reads in review, so a row without
# one is an exemption nobody agreed to.
download-coverage/Dockerfile|https://example.invalid/malformed-row.tar.gz|unversioned-url

# The component fixture's 1 download is deliberately left unanswered, so the
# unclassified detector has to report it.
